document.about: Cree CR4T downlight spec sheet (Canada). Its accessory and photometry tables sit under shaded title bands (Trims, Zonal Lumen Summary).

notes: 2026-11-24 (#109): a table whose title is read out above it presumed the row under the title its header. On page 1 the Trims table's first products named the products under them; the title row must earn the header, as the Zonal Lumen Summary's Zone | Lumens does over its figures.
